description: Antibody-secreting plasma cells; Prdm1, Xbp1, Sdc1 and Jchain are the standard plasma-cell program. Igha added because intestinal plasma cells are predominantly IgA, not IgG
Mature B lymphocytes; Cd79a/b added for robustness
UMBRELLA lymphoid cluster; pan-lymphoid genes added so CD3-negative NK and ILC subsets land here and reach the sub tier
UMBRELLA myeloid cluster; pan-myeloid genes added so dendritic cells, monocytes and neutrophils land here and reach the sub tier
Mast cells; Kit and Mcpt4 added. Intentionally defined at BOTH tiers as a safety net - see the sub-tier row

Interstitial Cells of Cajal - the pacemaker cells of the gut that generate slow-wave electrical activity driving colonic motility. Mesenchymal-origin, Kit+ Etv1+ Ano1+. Kit is shared with Mast cells, so Etv1 (lineage-specifying TF) and Ano1 (Ca2+-activated Cl- channel, DOG1) are the true discriminators; ICCs are Cpa3-/Fcer1a- unlike mast cells
Stromal fibroblasts defined by collagen expression; Pdgfra added
Smooth muscle cells (intestinal muscularis/visceral); Actg2, Acta2 and Myl9 added as verified SMC markers

subcluster_resolution: Vascular smooth muscle cells. CAUTION Notch3 is its only exclusive marker here but Notch3 is pan-mural (expressed by pericytes too). vSMC vs pericyte separation is intrinsically hard in scRNA-seq - consider merging if the clusters do not resolve

description: Grem2-high muscularis mucosae - a thin smooth-muscle layer at the crypt base that doubles as a stem-cell niche source. Carries a smooth-muscle contractile program (Myh11, Acta2, Cnn1) together with BMP-antagonist / niche factors (Grem2, Nog, Rspo3, Cd81); Foxl1-negative and Pdgfra-low, distinguishing it from telocytes. Lies directly beneath crypt-base ISCs and is a documented source of crypt-base BMP antagonism (Manieri et al. 2023, Dev Cell PMID 36924771), functionally overlapping trophocytes (McCarthy et al. 2020, Cell Stem Cell)
Enteric neurons; pan-neuronal markers added because Vip labels only a VIP-positive subset
Enteric glial cells (peripheral glia); S100b and Gfap added
Lymphatic endothelial cells; Prox1 is the canonical lymphatic transcription factor. Note Lyve1 is also expressed by resident macrophages
Vascular endothelial cells; Cdh5 and Pecam1 added so endothelium is identified as such. Pecam1 is now shared with LECs and therefore down-weighted automatically
Colonic epithelial cells (umbrella for all epithelial subtypes including goblet)
Adipocytes defined by lipid-storage genes; usually only recovered if mesenteric fat was included
Mucus-secreting goblet cells; first-pass separation from absorptive enterocytes
Enteroendocrine cells; rare hormone-secreting epithelial cells
Chemosensory tuft cells with brush-border morphology
Deep crypt secretory cells; niche support for stem cells. NOTE Reg4 is shared with goblet cells and Ccl6 is worth verifying against your reference
Absorptive colonocytes; mature ion-transport and lipid-handling cells
Transit-amplifying cells; actively cycling progenitors

Intestinal stem cells (crypt base columnar). Trimmed to 5 verified CBC markers. Lrig1 REMOVED - it marks a largely non-overlapping quiescent population in colon (Powell 2012, Cell), so mixing it with Lgr5 dilutes the signature. Olfm4 excluded - not expressed in mouse colon (Schuijers 2014)
ILC1; Tbx21-positive innate lymphoid cells, IFNg-producing, Eomes-negative and Prf1-negative (this is what separates them from NK)
ILC2; Gata3-high innate lymphoid cells, type 2 cytokine producers
ILC3; Rorc-positive innate lymphoid cells, IL-22-producing, NCR-positive and NCR-negative subsets
Natural killer cells; Eomes added as the standard discriminator from ILC1, plus cytotoxic effectors Gzma and Prf1
Mast cells; often co-cluster with lymphoid cells. Duplicated from the broad tier on purpose - the label is identical either way, so this is a safety net rather than a conflict
Helper T cells; Cd40lg and Il7r added because Cd4/Cd3 alone cannot distinguish this from the pan-T definition
Regulatory T cells; Foxp3 is the master transcription factor
Cytotoxic T cells; CD8-expressing effector and memory T cells
Cycling (proliferating) T cells
Gamma-delta T cells; innate-like T cell subset
Plasmacytoid DCs; Siglech and Bst2 positive, Itgax and Cd68 negative
cDC1; cross-presenting dendritic cells. The conflicting broad-tier cDCs row was removed so these cells reach this sub tier

cDC2; Cd209a, Clec10a (CD301a), Sirpa and Irf4 are verified mouse cDC2 markers. Clec4g and Siglecg were replaced NOT because they are absent from DCs (both are reported in DCs) but because both are non-specific in this panel - Clec4g also marks endothelium and Siglecg also marks B cells
Mature regulatory DCs; immunostimulatory and immunosuppressive programs co-expressed
Monocytes; Ly6c2-high, Adgre1 and Timd4 negative
Resting tissue-resident macrophages; no polarization markers
Pro-inflammatory program. NOTE M1/M2 is an in-vitro paradigm that maps imperfectly onto tissue macrophages; consider reporting these as programs rather than discrete identities
Anti-inflammatory program; see the M1 note on the M1/M2 paradigm
Proliferating macrophages

Neutrophils. WARNING neutrophils have low mRNA and high RNase content; published protocols use gene thresholds as low as 50 to retain them, whereas Script 01 defaults to POST_MIN_GENES=500 and POST_MAX_MT=5. Most neutrophils will be filtered out unless you relax those
